name: shell
description: Run a non-interactive POSIX shell command in the task environment. Supports pipes and redirects. Each call starts a fresh shell; cd and environment changes do not persist. Background services may continue after a completed command; their lifetime belongs to the caller or task environment. Redirect their stdout/stderr to a log file because output capture closes when the command exits. Timeout or cancellation stops the active command's process group. Returns JSON with exit_code, output (combined stdout/stderr, up to 32 KiB), timed_out, and truncated. This tool has the permissions of the running agent; cwd is not a filesystem sandbox.

cwd.description: Working directory, absolute or relative to the task directory; defaults to the task directory.

timeout.description: Command timeout in seconds; defaults to 60. The overall agent timeout still applies.
